facts.fact: Gundobar 执意把 Tilde 一行领进王宫正门，她们身不由己被塞进那座已经闹翻的大厅。
facts.anchor: Ushered ahead by an insistent Gundobar

facts.fact: 被控致人死亡的 Conrin 王子当庭抗辩：杀人的是那匹马，不是他；一蹄子踢不死人，死者必定心脏不好。
facts.anchor: ‘I hold that it was the horse that killed them!’ stated Conrin over the noise.

facts.fact: Conrin 提出用 trial of advocacy 了结此案：十二名贵族或教士宣誓担保他的品行，指控即可撤销。
facts.anchor: Advocacy. Twelve noblemen or priests had only to stand with him

facts.fact: Gundobar 当众把 Tilde 推出来「裁定此案」，天鹅国王的蓝眼睛随即落到她身上。
facts.anchor: Perhaps the new queen-to-be can settle the matter.

facts.fact: Liran 判赔：自耕农家一枚金币、其领主三枚银币、马妇家两枚银币，理由是自耕农是打仗的人。
facts.anchor: One gold will be paid to the Cynghal yeoman’s family, three silver to his erl

facts.fact: Liran 当众掌掴儿子 Conrin，宣称他必须服从自己为维系王国而定下的法律。
facts.anchor: ‘You are my subject, Prince Conrin!’ snarled his father, lowering his hand.

facts.fact: 章末 Tilde 断定这座宫廷的硬壳下有裂缝，并想着如何把一颗种子种进去撑裂它。
facts.anchor: There was a frailty here, cracks under the hard surface.

facts.fact: 全章最后一句是母亲说过的话：这不是狩猎，必须是屠杀。
facts.anchor: This is not a hunt, my mother had said. This must be a massacre.
